feature_contract.goal: Bind game offscreen color Draw to the exact source texture, mip and array slice of native GPU Copy/Stretch

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Copy/Stretch counts color only if the exact camera source had an eligible Draw
Clear invalidates stale proof; unrelated postpasses retain original GPU chronology and DX9Ex/input/FFB
Compile static identity regressions and five required GitHub Actions

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: SOURCE_STAGE_NOT_GAMEPLAY_VERIFIED: offscreen camera GPU color copied to XR eyes is source-authenticated, but no matching OutRun menu/car/race or HMD observation.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Do not promote native renderer or drop game GPU commands. Unsupported/unproven source postpasses do not certify XR eye; original D3D9/DX9Ex/FFB/input path remains authoritative.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Four real offscreen native game Draw/Indexed/Instanced variants record source texture+mip+array; GPU Copy and filtered Stretch import color evidence only from the identical view.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Other camera resource, array eye and mip, never-written camera or source reset by GPU TARGET Clear do not certify stale postpass; no GPU command or D3D9 path removed.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Camera Draw/source Clear lifecycle and chronological native L/R Copy/Stretch postpasses share a bounded per-eye provenance ledger, with static positive/negative identity assertions and exact-SHA build gates.
